seoTitle: How to Order Animations in Canva (Timing Guide)
metaDescription: Control the timing and sequence of animated elements in Canva using the Show Timing panel to sync graphics with voiceover or music.
intro: When you have multiple animated elements on a single design, getting them to appear in the right order and at the right time makes all the difference for a polished result. Canva's timeline and layers panel let you adjust exactly when each element enters and exits, so your animation matches your voiceover or music cues.

steps.heading: Open the animation dashboard
steps.body: Select an element on your design and open its animation options.

steps.heading: Access Show Timing
steps.body: Right-click the element to access the Show Timing panel, which controls when it appears relative to others.

steps.heading: Review the timeline bars
steps.body: Look at the layer timeline bars on the canvas grid to understand the current sequencing of your elements.

steps.heading: Shift start and end points
steps.body: Adjust each element's start and end points to reorder when it appears on screen.

steps.heading: Match animations to audio cues
steps.body: Align your text and graphic animations with corresponding points in your voiceover or background music.

steps.heading: Fine-tune transitions and preview
steps.body: Adjust fade and transition speeds for overlapping items, then review the final playback before exporting.

faq.question: How do I control which element animates first?
faq.answer: The Show Timing panel, accessed by right-clicking an element, lets you set each item's start and end points to control the animation order.

faq.question: Can I sync animations with background music?
faq.answer: Yes, by adjusting timing points you can line up when text or graphics appear to match cues in your audio track.

faq.question: What happens if two animations overlap unintentionally?
faq.answer: You can adjust fade and transition speeds for overlapping items to smooth out the effect, or shift their timing so they don't collide.

faq.question: Does this work for video clips as well as text and graphics?
faq.answer: Yes, the timeline and Show Timing controls apply to video clips, text boxes, and graphics alike.
